snippet.title: Windows Mario World will never be finished, but here's the lastest build
snippet.description:
I haven't worked on this since 2018, and don't have any plans on revisiting it. Feel free to download the latest build, or any of the previous builds, from this GitHub repository: https://github.com/pdnelson/Windows-Mario-World

All builds are unlocked, so feel free to use this for your own hacks, or make it so that all the complete levels are accessible. The latest build that is available is exactly as I left it in 2018, so I didn't make any additional changes to make it to make all the complete levels accessible.

Anyway, enjoy!
